## What you have

- Printer (model, and the multi-material unit if there is one):
- Graphics card (model, VRAM):
- CPU and RAM:
- Free Print Station version:
- Blender version, if the sprite tools were run:

## What happened

What was expected, and what happened instead.

## Proof

The print file, the screenshot, or the error text. A screenshot of the error
is worth more than a description of it.

## Printer and card details

Only what is needed to reproduce: the model and the firmware version. Leave
out the serial number, the access code and the IP address.
